title: A phase space approach to the wavefunction spreading and operator growth in the Krylov basis
summary: In the Wigner-Weyl phase space formulation of quantum mechanics, we analyse the problem of the spreading of an initial state or an initial operator under time evolution when described in terms of the Krylov basis.
